policy: Every substantive manuscript claim must have one explicit marker and a bounded evidence class. Historical evidence, the completed action-policy result, and unavailable independent evidence must remain distinguishable.

claims.statement: GFS separates a frozen stable simulator from default-off research world-model and cognition layers and verifies the active release artifact chain.
claims.allowed_scope: software architecture and repository integrity only
claims.forbidden_inference: scientific benefit, production deployment, or real-world causal validity

claims.statement: The frozen evidence report covers a 128 team-match StatsBomb benchmark and derived observations from SkillCorner, StatsBomb 360, Sportec IDSSE, and Metrica sources with provider-specific limitations.
claims.forbidden_inference: representativeness of all football or causal transport to deployed decisions

claims.statement: Frozen M0 passed the repository external calibration contract on 18 full-length simulations across six fixtures and three seeds.
claims.forbidden_inference: comparison with the new 30-pair confirmatory M1 protocol

claims.statement: A prior sealed 18-match M1 review found no behavior change above tolerance and no resolved external-loss improvement, so M1 remains research-only and default-off.
claims.forbidden_inference: a result from the new preregistered 30-pair confirmatory experiment

claims.statement: The fixed action-policy comparison completed all 30 matched pairs and 60 runs; all pairs changed behavior, but the external-loss interval crossed zero and the sealed decision kept M1 research-only without promotion.
claims.allowed_scope: the frozen 30-pair simulator-internal action-policy comparison and its deterministic replay
claims.forbidden_inference: M1 promotion, real-football causality, external deployment benefit, or independent reproduction

claims.statement: The active stable release remains 7.0.0 and neither existing M1 evidence nor the preregistration changes the production pointer.
claims.forbidden_inference: external production readiness or signed release promotion

claims.statement: All reported effects are simulator-internal; real-world causal claims are forbidden by the frozen research scope.
claims.forbidden_inference: real-team, player, coaching, or societal causal effects

claims.statement: No reproduction by a person independent of the implementer has been completed.
